observations: Actual EntitiesMCA registers grim_reaper as MONSTER with dimensions1x2.6, fire-immune builder and GrimReaper attributes; its local bootstrap registers the deferred registry. Entity installs target goal and Rest/Melee/Idle goals; registers tracked ATTACK_STAGE defaultIDLE. Entity maxHP300/attack10, flight controller/navigation and noGravity support the combat context. Loader invocation and Architectury registration internals were not expanded.

Damage checks exact IN_WALL/ON_FIRE/EXPLOSION/IN_FIRE types first and returns false; IN_WALL also requests teleport+3Y. This exact-type branch is not every possible tagged fire/explosion. Next, stateBLOCK with nonnull attacker plays block sound then returns false. It does not require nonprojectile damage and has no local per-target sound throttle; environmental damage with null attacker does not enter this particular branch.

Next, direct source ProjectileEntity, state!=REST, nonnull attacker and randomboolean cause a nearby-attacker teleport request and unconditional false. No teleport-success receipt gates denial. The subsequent independent server-only >=.30 roll with attacker requests behind-attacker teleport but continues through damage; zero horizontal distance is not locally guarded before division. REST then scales amount by0.25; super.damage decides final accepted result. Neither movement nor unchanged health alone proves a refusal.

Rest admission: age>lastHeal+1000, HP<=maxHP*(1-(healingCount+1)/5). Fields start lastHeal=-1000, healingCount0; start requests+8Y teleport, sets time400, records currentage and increments count. Each tick decrements time, setsREST and zeros velocity; server at modulo(10+count*5)==0 calls setHealth(current+1), each50 requests lightning and each100 a zombie/skeleton with equipment. No spawn-success requirement except null guard before equipment; direct health call is not a LivingHeal return receipt. Continue whiletime>0, canStopfalse; stop setsIDLE. Counter changes admission threshold/rate, not a new owner per threshold or stage.

Melee admission needs target within distance-squared144, age>lastAttack+150, and state!=REST; startsets block50/attack100/retreat20. Continue requires retreat>0 andnotREST; tick rechecks REST. BLOCK countdown setsBLOCK, retreats by teleport if close and sets upwardvelocity; at block expiry curse optionally teleports behind a blocking player, server80% swaps two hotbar slots then requestsblindness. PRE accelerates toward target; close-range swing endsattack, requestsdamage and independentlywither without testing hurt acceptance. POST retreats20 then stopsetsIDLE. BothRest andMelee lack explicit goal controls and cannotStop, whileIdle claimsMOVE and lacksREST gate. Thus numeric priority alone is not proof of serialized exclusive phases. NativeGoalSelector arbitration was not read/run; no actual stage race asserted.

Target goal polls via a counter, gathers eligible players, sorts descendingY then selects first passing isTarget; continuation only checks targetnonnull. Idle chooses targetposition or NoWaterTargeting and calls navigation without success check. Entity tick clearsdeadtarget and setsIDLE; configdisallow requestsdiscard without immediate return; HP<=0zerosvelocity thenreturns. These are source-level exits, not native removal/goal scheduling guarantees.

SetAttackState writes onlyonchange and requests scythe-out sound forPRE and swing sound forPOST. ServerWorld requestTeleport emits enderman sound beforeandafter native void request. Thus statechange sounds, per-block sounds and teleport attempt sounds have different triggers; none is a validated per-hit immune result. Native bossbar separately useshealth/max and tracking membership.

CTrackedEntity forwards through CDataManager; Entry creates integer trackeddata, registersdefault, gets/sets viaDataTracker. CEnumParameter bounds invalid index todefault and supplies explicit NBTload/save helpers. GrimReaper entireclass has no customNBT override or calls toDATA.load/save; rest/melee counters have no own save/load. This inspected chain provides no durable combat-phase restore contract. Generic helper capability is not an automatic persistence call; external engine/mixin coverage is not exhaustive.

Client renderer usesgrimreaper texture and fixedscale. Full model readsattackstate and maps PRE/POST/BLOCK/REST to poses; resets baseline body/legs/scythe thenapplies set andcopieshat. This is stage display, not a distinct rejection packet, text or accepted-hit feedback. ModelTransformSet math, loader renderregistration, actualtexture/audio resources and native transport were not expanded. No art/pose modification was made.
